mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 8.0% signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite UNRATE crossing above 8.0%, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and increase in GDP demand (GDPC1) amplifies equity market optimism, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in the walk-forward test, or returns do not follow the predicted direction when both proxies move in tandem.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below 95.0 signals weakening supply-side growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO decline does not correlate with negative returns in late-cycle expansions, or the regime is not active (e.g., during a contraction).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in labor force participation (PAYEMS) above 131,000 signals a robust job market, boosting consumer confidence and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when PAYEMS rises, or the effect diminishes over time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, signaling aggressive monetary tightening, higher borrowing costs suppress equity valuations and drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite FEDFUNDS crossing above 4.5%, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Convergence of GDP demand (GDPC1) above 13,000 and industrial production (INDPRO) above 95.0 indicates balanced economic growth, amplifying equity market gains and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in the walk-forward test, or returns do not follow the predicted direction when both proxies converge.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in the federal funds rate above 3.5% signals higher policy rates, increasing borrowing costs and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite FEDFUNDS rising in a tightening cycle, or the regime is not active (e.g., during an easing phase).
